description: Scammer poses as federal law enforcement claiming victim SIM card was used in cybercrime, demanding isolation and security deposit escrow.

events.description: Automated call from +919876500000: Telecom Regulatory Authority - Your phone line will be disconnected in 2 hours for cyber offenses.
WhatsApp from fake police badge: CBI Arrest Warrant #CW-89241 issued for financial money laundering.
Impersonator demands victim state national Aadhaar/PAN number for official police clearance verification
Transfer 100,000 INR to Supreme Court RBI Clearance Escrow account escrow.verify@fakeupi for asset clearance
Victim prepares wire transfer under coercive intimidation

evidence.observation: Scammer claims to represent Central Bureau of Investigation and Mumbai Cyber Crime Cell
Threat of immediate physical arrest and asset forfeiture unless victim complies
Victim ordered to remain on secret Skype surveillance line without notifying anyone
Victim sent forged document bearing fake Supreme Court seal
Demand for victim money transfer to personal escrow VPA escrow.verify@fakeupi
